summary: Router 0.21.1 adds self-tests for three open P1 evidence gaps and fixes the two defects they found. TM-05: test/selftest_cloud_final_payload.py checks that memory is inserted before the cloud checks (proxy._prepare calls memory.prepare before _cloud_ordered, which takes cloud.request_block_reason on that body), that the credential scan finds a secret in an inserted fact, and that with the privacy exception the provider receives the final payload. Defect: memory.packed escapes non-ASCII characters, so privacy.user_texts passed escaped JSON to the rules and the classifier and a configured term such as a name with an umlaut in a recalled fact did not keep the request local. Fix: memory.unpacked_texts decodes the facts of a data message that starts with memory.NOTICE (json.loads guarded, a look-alike message stays plain text) and privacy.user_texts adds them; the model-facing format is unchanged. TM-09: test/selftest_isolation_rotation.py runs the router from a temporary configuration file with the gateway enabled, a mocked session store and a control user: every gateway route refuses requests without identity or with a wrong token, the same alias maps to a bank per client, a token rotation through POST /admin/clients/{name}/token refuses the old token on REST recall, gateway recall and session read while the new token works and another client is unaffected, and a read grant revoked in the file and reloaded refuses recall with 403 while the identity stays valid. TM-15: test/selftest_log_hygiene_paths.py puts canaries on automatic recall, curated and answer retention, memory and inference backend error bodies and the session API, and checks log records and the journal, with instrument checks. Defect: an unexpected session-store exception reached the log with its message through aiohttp's default handler. Fix (ADR-0062): unexpected.unexpected_error_middleware is the outermost middleware of both apps; it passes web.HTTPException, logs type, method, path, a reference and code locations without the message or chained exceptions, and answers a fixed 500 internal_error with the reference.

findings.evidence: A recalled fact 'Termin bei Frau Müller' with privacy term 'Müller' was sent to the cloud provider: the inserted data message carried 'M\u00fcller'.
findings.resolution: privacy.user_texts reads inserted facts decoded; covered by selftest_cloud_final_payload. Classifier quality and tool results remain open.

findings.evidence: Gateway routes were only enumerated with the gateway disabled; rotation and revocation were untested.
findings.resolution: Tested with the gateway enabled, real token rotation and grant revocation by reload; no defect found. Deployment coverage remains.

findings.evidence: A session-store exception text carrying a canary appeared in the log (aiohttp 'Error handling request' traceback).
findings.resolution: Last-resort middleware logs type and code locations only (ADR-0062); canaries on memory, session and backend error paths. Rotation and backups remain open.

tests.command: python test/selftest_cloud_final_payload.py; python test/selftest_isolation_rotation.py; python test/selftest_log_hygiene_paths.py (WSL)
Negative checks: selftest_cloud_final_payload before the privacy fix; selftest_log_hygiene_paths without the middleware
tests.evidence: 3 failures (term passed, classifier saw escaped JSON, provider called); 'store exception leaked into the log'.

tests.command: All python test/... commands of ci.yml (WSL) after rebase onto #108; check_control_flow; check_adr_index; ruff check .
tests.evidence: No failures; ADR index ok: 62 ADRs; control flow ok; All checks passed.

limitations: The privacy classifier is stubbed; its quality on real text is not measured.
Code locations in the unexpected-error log include source lines, which are code, not data; the message itself is withheld and is lost for debugging.
